metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code (and GitHub Copilot for think): my-react (React/TS contract flow + driver agents), my-flutter (Flutter/Dart rules + skills), think (gated workflow for working with agents). Install any subset with install.py.

plugins.name: my-react
plugins.description: React/TS spec-driven workflow: driver-embedded phase process, contract skills, atlas auditor, driver + worker agents.

plugins.name: my-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter/Dart spec-driven skills: AC authoring, architecture design (P1–P8), Riverpod, test quality, PR review.

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: Gated workflow for working with agents, for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: prompt → design (optional) → build (code) or write (non-code) → review (optional); explore as a companion; builder, writer, explorer, reviewer agents.
